Writes the content of a buffer into a picture file. Saving the front buffer after a [Flip](Flip) makes a screenshot.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
Color 255, 255, 255
Text 160, 120, "Screenshot", 1, 1
Flip
If SaveBuffer(FrontBuffer(), "screenshot.bmp") Then Print "saved" Else Print "failed"
WaitKey
```
@param buffer   The buffer to save.
@param bmpfile  The path of the file to write.
@returns 1 if the file was written, otherwise 0.
@gap A name that ends with `.png` gives a PNG file and any other name a BMP file.
